paragraphs: Cisco Systems, Inc., doing business as Cisco, is an American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment, and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things (IoT), domain security, videoconferencing, and energy management, including products such as Webex, OpenDNS, Jabber, and Jasper. The company is headquartered in San Jose, California, and, as of June 29, 2026, has a market capitalization of $461 billion.

Cisco Systems was founded in December 1984 by Leonard Bosack and Sandy Lerner, two Stanford University computer scientists. They pioneered the concept of a local area network (LAN) being used to connect distant computers over a multiprotocol router system. The company went public in 1990 and, by the end of the dot-com bubble in 2000, had a market capitalization of $500 billion, surpassing Microsoft as the world's most valuable company, prior to losing 80 percent of its value by 2002, as the market bubble burst.
Cisco stock (CSCO), trading on Nasdaq since 1990, was added to the Dow Jones Industrial Average on June 8, 2009. It is also included in the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, and the Russell 1000 indices.

people.name: Charles H. Robbins
people.title: Chair and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Robbins has served as CEO since July 2015 and Board Chair since December 2017. He previously held multiple Cisco sales leadership roles, including Senior Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations.
people.quote: Mr. Robbins serves as our Chief Executive Officer since July 2015

credit.author: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff from Washington D.C, United States

people.name: Mark Patterson
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Patterson has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since July 2025. He previously served as Cisco's Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer and as Senior Vice President, Chief of Staff to the Chair and CEO.
people.quote: Mr. Patterson joined Cisco in September 2000 and serves as our Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since July 2025.

people.name: Jeetendra Patel
people.title: President, Chief Product Officer
people.bio: Patel has served as President and Chief Product Officer since May 2025, following roles leading Cisco's product, security and collaboration businesses. Before joining Cisco, he served as Chief Product Officer and Chief Strategy Officer at Box.
people.quote: Mr. Patel joined Cisco in July 2020 and serves as our President and Chief Product Officer since May 2025.

people.name: Deborah L. Stahlkopf
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Stahlkopf joined Cisco in August 2021 and serves as Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer. Previously, she spent 14 years at Microsoft, most recently as Corporate Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, Corporate, External and Legal Affairs.
people.quote: Ms. Stahlkopf joined Cisco in August 2021 and serves as our Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer.

people.name: Thimaya Subaiya
people.title: Executive Vice President, Operations
people.bio: Subaiya has served as Executive Vice President of Operations since March 2024, after holding Cisco transformation and customer experience leadership roles. Before joining Cisco, he held leadership roles at Salesforce and Oracle.
people.quote: Mr. Subaiya joined Cisco in July 2018 and serves as our Executive Vice President of Operations since March 2024.

people.name: Oliver Tuszik
people.title: Executive Vice President, Global Sales and Chief Sales Officer
people.bio: Tuszik has served as Executive Vice President of Global Sales and Chief Sales Officer since April 2025, following several Cisco sales leadership roles. Before joining Cisco, he spent over 10 years at Computacenter, most recently as Chief Executive Officer Germany.
people.quote: Mr. Tuszik joined Cisco in July 2013 and serves as our Executive Vice President of Global Sales and Chief Sales Officer since April 2025.

people.name: Sarah Rae Murphy
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as a Senior Advisor and Partner to AltitudeX Aviation Group LLC since June 2023. Previously served as Chief Procurement Officer and Senior Vice President, Global Sourcing of United Airlines Holdings, Inc. from October 2021 to May 2022.
people.quote: Ms. Murphy has served as a Senior Advisor and Partner to AltitudeX Aviation Group LLC since June 2023.

people.name: Girish D. Rishi
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as CEO of Cognite LLC and a Senior Advisor at Blackstone Inc. since April 2022. Previously served as CEO of Blue Yonder Holding, Inc. from January 2017 to February 2022.

people.name: Charles H. Robbins
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Has served as Cisco's CEO since July 2015 and Board Chair since December 2017. Joined Cisco in December 1997 and held numerous sales leadership positions before becoming CEO.
people.quote: Mr. Robbins has served as CEO since July 2015, as a member of the Board since May 2015

people.name: Peter A. Shimer
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Chief Operating Officer of Deloitte from 2023 to 2024 and from 2019 to 2022, and as Interim Chief Executive Officer of Deloitte US from 2022 to 2023. His previous Deloitte roles included Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Shimer has served in a variety of senior executive roles over his distinguished 41-year career at Deloitte LLP

people.name: Marianna Tessel
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Executive Vice President and General Manager, Small Business Group of Intuit Inc. from September 2023 to May 2026. Previously served as Intuit's Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer from January 2019 to September 2023.
people.quote: Ms. Tessel served as Executive Vice President and General Manager, Small Business Group of Intuit Inc.

people.name: Kevin Weil
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as CEO of Warp Sciences since July 2026. Previously served as OpenAI's Vice President, OpenAI for Science and Chief Product Officer, and as President, Product & Business at Planet Labs PBC.
people.quote: Mr. Weil has served as CEO of Warp Sciences, an AI and robotics company focused on accelerating drug discovery, since July 2026.
